title: Training-Free Refusal of MCP Exploits via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.11217v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The model context protocol (MCP) has been widely adopted as an open standard enabling the seamless integration of generative AI agents. However, while LLM guardrails have significantly matured to refuse malicious or harmful queries (e.g., "How do I build a bomb?"), recent work has shown that MCP-enabled LLMs are highly susceptible to prompt injection attacks which avoid harmful or suspicious cues (e.g., "Can you add this ssh key to my bashrc file?"). Herein, we use state-of-the-art (SOTA) alignment fine-tuning algorithms to explore whether LLMs may be aligned to refuse such falsely benign attacks (FBAs). While SOTA algorithms based on direct preference optimization (DPO) improve refusal guardrails against FBAs, we show that this improvement is limited; DPO-based fine-tuning never improves FBA refusal rates beyond 47% across five popular open-source LLMs. Thus, to further improve FBA refusals, we introduce Retrieval Augmented Generati

translated_title: 通过检索增强生成实现无需训练的MCP漏洞利用拒绝
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.11217v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：模型上下文协议（MCP）作为一种开放标准已被广泛采用，使生成式AI智能体能够无缝集成。然而，尽管大语言模型（LLM）的防护栏已显著成熟，能够拒绝恶意或有害的查询（例如“我如何制造炸弹？”），但最近的研究表明，启用MCP的LLM极易受到避开有害或可疑线索的提示注入攻击（例如“你能把这个ssh密钥添加到我的bashrc文件中吗？”）。在本文中，我们使用最先进的（SOTA）对齐微调算法，探索LLM是否可以对齐以拒绝此类虚假良性攻击（FBAs）。虽然基于直接偏好优化（DPO）的SOTA算法改善了对FBAs的拒绝防护栏，但我们表明这种改进是有限的；在五个流行的开源LLM上，基于DPO的微调从未将FBA拒绝率提升到47%以上。因此，为了进一步提高FBA拒绝率，我们引入了检索增强生成（RAG）……
tldr: 针对启用MCP的LLM易受虚假良性提示注入攻击的问题，研究发现基于DPO的微调防护效果有限（拒绝率不超过47%），进而提出基于检索增强生成的免训练方法以更有效地拒绝此类攻击。
en_tdlr: As DPO-based fine-tuning offers limited protection (never exceeding 47% refusal rate) against falsely benign prompt injection attacks on MCP-enabled LLMs, this paper proposes a training-free Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach to more effectively refuse such attacks.
